subject.title: feat(onboarding): prefer strongest local model in guided detection

question: Should this fixed, retunable local-model family ranking become a public plugin SDK contract, or remain an onboarding-owned internal policy?
rationale: The answer determines whether external plugins may depend on the ranking semantics and whether future benchmark-driven changes require compatibility treatment.

options.title: Keep Policy Internal
options.body: Share the ranking through an onboarding-owned internal or injected seam so its ordering can evolve without creating an external plugin contract.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Contract
options.body: Keep the export, but explicitly define its compatibility guarantees, intended external use, retuning policy, documentation, and focused contract tests.

recommendation.title: Keep Policy Internal
recommendation.body: Share the ranking through an onboarding-owned internal or injected seam so its ordering can evolve without creating an external plugin contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence most directly connects this person to the local-model onboarding direction and the proposed shared SDK boundary.
